requirements: ChatGPT Pro, Plus, Team, or Enterprise account
Developer Mode enabled in Settings > Security & Login
Server running in HTTP transport mode (MCP_TRANSPORT=http PORT=8000 uv run server.py)
setup_steps: 1. Run server in HTTP mode: MCP_TRANSPORT=http PORT=8000 uv run server.py
2. Expose local port 8000 if testing locally: ngrok http 8000
3. Open ChatGPT > Settings > Security & login > Enable Developer mode
4. Add new MCP server with the HTTPS URL provided by ngrok/cloudflared
5. Use tools (query_telemetry, query_store_inventory) directly in ChatGPT chat
documentation.verified_source: OpenAI Developer Platform (ChatGPT MCP & Developer Mode Specification, 2026)
